components.label: Transform
components.help: Place an entity in the world. Values are in metres.

properties.label: X
properties.help: Horizontal position

properties.label: Y
properties.help: Vertical position

properties.label: Z
properties.help: Depth position

properties.label: Rotation X
properties.help: Fixed-axis rotations: apply X, then Y, then Z.

properties.label: Rotation Y
properties.help: Fixed-axis rotations: apply X, then Y, then Z.

properties.label: Rotation Z
properties.help: Fixed-axis rotations: apply X, then Y, then Z.

properties.label: Scale X
properties.help: Positive local axis scale.

properties.label: Scale Y
properties.help: Positive local axis scale.

properties.label: Scale Z
properties.help: Positive local axis scale.

components.label: Renderable
components.help: Opaque flat or textured unlit preview. Tint is linear RGB; PNG colors are sRGB. Lighting/shadows are not previewed by this adapter.

properties.label: Mesh
properties.help: Choose a project-declared mesh.

properties.label: Color texture
properties.help: Choose a project-declared texture.

properties.label: Visible in preview
properties.help: Hidden objects are omitted from the preview.

properties.label: Tint R
properties.help: Tint R for the 3D preview.

properties.label: Tint G
properties.help: Tint G for the 3D preview.

properties.label: Tint B
properties.help: Tint B for the 3D preview.

components.label: Light
components.help: Authored photometric light. Uses a rigid Transform with -Z forward; no light is added automatically.

properties.label: Kind
properties.help: Point and spot intensity is candela; directional intensity is lux.

properties.label: Enabled
properties.help: Enable this authored light in Lit mode.

properties.label: Red
properties.help: Linear RGB hue.

properties.label: Green
properties.help: Linear RGB hue.

properties.label: Blue
properties.help: Linear RGB hue.

properties.label: Intensity
properties.help: Candela for point/spot; lux for directional.

properties.label: Range
properties.help: Finite point and spot attenuation range.

properties.label: Inner half angle
properties.help: Spot cone: inner must be less than outer.

properties.label: Outer half angle
properties.help: Spot cone half angle, less than 90 degrees.

components.label: Luminaire
components.help: Analytic LED panel with steered Gaussian beams (Steinberg's slice sampling, section 6). Uses a rigid Transform: the panel emits along -Z and its tile columns run along +X. Only render graphs that read luminaires, such as the slice-sampling-luminaire template, are lit by it.

properties.label: Enabled
properties.help: Light render graphs that read luminaires.

properties.label: Half extent
properties.help: Half the side of the square panel.

properties.label: Radiance scale
properties.help: Multiplies every tile's radiance; sampling is unchanged.

properties.label: Beam width
properties.help: Gaussian width of every tile's beams; tiles vary it by 0.8 to 1.2 times.

properties.label: Beam steering
properties.help: Offset of each tile's beams along its own steering direction.

properties.label: Beam spread
properties.help: Slope change per half extent of panel position; widens the footprint.

properties.label: Beam twist
properties.help: Rotational slope change per half extent of panel position.
